messages:
Cameron Reed: FYI — NimbusEdge wants a lightweight signed upload + webhook contract for device metering. They9ll push daily gzipped CSVs to our intake S3 and hit /v1/partner/manifest with a manifest + signature.
Nora Vasquez: High level ok. Need clear spec: hash algorithm, signature type, manifest schema, dedupe key, and backfill window. Finance: we9ll require daily recon with automatic outlier alerting.
Ibrahim Khan: Proposed constraints:
- Manifest JSON: {"partner_id":"nimbusedge","files":[{"name":"usage-2026-04-01.gz","sha256":"<hex>","rows":12345}],"generated_at":"2026-04-01T02:00:00Z"}
- Signature over raw manifest bytes using ed25519 (partner pubkey in partner_keys)
- CSV header: event_id,timestamp_iso,device_id,customer_id,partner_sku,units
- Dedupe key: event_id (bulk TTL 45d)
- Time normalization: accept timezone offsets, store both original_iso and normalized_utc
- Backfill policy: default accept up to 60 days; allow 180 days with COE ticket and finance sign-off
FinanceBot: Rule: daily delta > 1% flagged for manual review. Keep artifacts (manifest + sig + sample rows + ingest log) for 365d.
Nora Vasquez: Error response examples to share with partner:
```
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{ "error":"invalid_manifest", "detail":"missing files array" }
```
```
HTTP/1.1 422 Unprocessable Entity
{ "error":"delta_too_high", "detail":"daily delta 2.4% for sku redwood:dedicated:gpu.standard.hour" }
```
Ibrahim Khan: Implementation notes: verify sha256 checksum of uploaded file before parsing; verify ed25519 signature; stream-parse CSV to avoid memory spikes; write event_ids to dedupe store atomically. For out-of-order batches run recompute job and annotate aggregates with replay_tag.
PartnerBot: Automated check: manifest schema validated (schema:partner-manifest-v2). Dry-run results will be posted to #partnerships-dry-run with delta summary and top 10 unmatched SKUs.
Cameron Reed: Action items:
- @Ibrahim: draft manifest + signature verification spec + sample curl/webhook examples (PR by Thu)
- @Nora: confirm backfill escalation flow and COE ticket template
- @Cameron: ask NimbusEdge for a sample gz + sig for dry-run next week
- @FinanceBot: add recon thresholds and retention requirements to billing runbook
Nora Vasquez: Target: dry-run Wednesday. If delta < 0.5% we schedule gated production. Ping here for blockers. :white_check_mark:
